name: StepFenv
description: Touch-gated tempo-synced step filter envelope for NTS-3. Dry until the pad is held; each period retriggers a cutoff envelope into a resonant low-pass on AUDIO IN. X = cutoff, Y = env depth. Touch starts the grid; release returns to bypass.

params.name: ENV
params.detail: How far each step opens the cutoff above CUT

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: SHAPE
params.detail: Envelope curve: Saw, Rise, Tri, Sigm, Puls
